title: Sodium FPS Cap Fix
description: Adds an FPS cap textbox and removes Minecraft's 260 FPS ceiling. Works with or without Sodium.
body:
Sodium FPS Cap Fix adds a textbox for Minecraft's FPS cap and removes the vanilla 260 FPS ceiling, so you can type the cap you actually want instead of being stuck with the slider.

Sodium is optional now. If Sodium is installed, this replaces Sodium's FPS cap control with the textbox. If Sodium is not installed, the normal Video Settings FPS cap control is replaced instead.

Features:
- Type a custom FPS cap instead of dragging a slider
- Allows values above Minecraft's normal 260 FPS slider limit
- Saves the chosen value between launches
- Works with Sodium installed
- Works without Sodium installed

Supported versions:
- Fabric 1.20.1
- Fabric 1.21.1
- Fabric 1.21.11
- Fabric 26.1.2
- Fabric 26.2
- NeoForge 1.21.1
- NeoForge 1.21.11
- NeoForge 26.1.2
- NeoForge 26.2

Notes:
- Client-side only
- Sodium is optional, not required
- Fabric 1.21.11 also handles Reese's Sodium Options 2.x
- Only Fabric and NeoForge are supported
